description: An endpoint's recent delivery attempts, newest first: event type, status (PENDING = mid-retry, DELIVERED, FAILED), attempt count, HTTP response status, and the last error. Payloads are not included. get_webhook_delivery returns the exact JSON body that was sent. Requires the MANAGER role or above.

endpointId.description: Webhook endpoint id (uuid): list_webhook_endpoints returns these

name: list_webhook_deliveries
title: List webhook deliveries
